description: Discover the 2019 Chrysler Pacifica Touring L, a versatile family van built for comfort and convenience. Featuring a striking Velvet Red Pearlcoat exterior and a sleek black interior, this used passenger van combines style with practicality. With just over 81,000 miles, it offers a reliable drive powered by a 3.6-liter V6 engine paired with a smooth 9-speed automatic transmission, delivering 287 horsepower and 262 lb-ft of torque. Designed for everyday family needs, it boasts a spacious seating arrangement for seven, including a third-row seat, and a variety of modern features like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth connectivity, and a backup camera. Safety and technology go hand-in-hand with blind spot monitoring, cross traffic alert, heated seats, keyless entry, push start, rear A/C, and satellite radio readiness, making every journey comfortable and connected. This Chrysler Pacifica is equipped with advanced safety features to keep your family secure on the road. It includes rear automatic emergency braking, dual knee airbags for the front seats, and rear parking sensors to assist with parking. The vehicle is fitted with four-wheel anti-lock braking system (ABS), emergency braking preparation, anti-lockout power door locks, auto-locking door locks, brake drying to improve braking performance, and an electronic parking brake with auto-off functionality. These features work together to provide peace of mind and enhance overall safety during daily commutes and longer trips alike. 2019 Chrysler Pacifica Safety and Security Features This Pacifica prioritizes safety with rear automatic emergency braking that helps prevent collisions, dual front knee airbags for added protection, and rear parking sensors to aid in parking maneuvers. It is equipped with four-wheel ABS and emergency braking preparation features that enhance braking response in critical moments. Anti-lockout power door locks and auto-locking locks improve security, while brake drying ensures consistent stopping power in wet conditions. An electronic parking brake with auto-off adds convenience and safety during parking. 2019 Chrysler Pacifica Entertainment and Technology Features Entertainment and connectivity are well-covered with a voice-operated hands-free phone call system and a voice-controlled radio, ensuring easy access to your favorite tunes and calls. The infotainment system features a 7-inch touchscreen display and a touch screen radio, providing intuitive control over media and settings. Electronic messaging assistance with read and voice functions keeps you connected without distraction. The van offers six speakers and auxiliary inputs including USB and iPod/iPhone compatibility, delivering a rich audio experience for all passengers. 2019 Chrysler Pacifica Performance Features The Pacifica Touring L includes auto start/stop technology to improve fuel efficiency and reduce emissions. Its tuned suspension is designed for a smooth ride, making daily driving and longer trips more comfortable. These performance features enhance the overall driving experience, combining efficiency with responsive handling to meet the demands of family life.

description: 2013 Toyota Sienna XLE — Silver Sky Metallic exterior with a Light Gray leather-trim interior. This well-maintained Sienna is powered by Toyota’s smooth 3.5L V6 (266 hp, 245 lb-ft) paired with a responsive 6-speed automatic transmission. It delivers an EPA-estimated 18 MPG city / 25 MPG highway and is in excellent overall condition with a clean CARFAX. Factory-equipped XLE features you’ll appreciate: - Seating & Comfort: Factory XLE trim includes seating for eight with roomy second- and third-row accommodations. Leather-trimmed seating, heated front seats, and a power-adjustable driver’s seat provide long-trip comfort. The third row folds down to expand cargo space when needed. Tri-zone automatic climate control keeps driver, front passenger, and rear passengers comfortable. - Convenience: Power sliding side doors and a power rear liftgate make loading kids, cargo, and groceries simple and convenient. Power windows and door locks, remote keyless entry, and cruise control are standard. Roof rails add practicality for extra cargo-carrying needs. - Interior Amenities & Storage: Multiple storage compartments, cupholders for every row, and a versatile seating layout make this Sienna a family-friendly hauler. The cabin’s Light Gray finish gives a bright, comfortable interior feel. - Infotainment & Connectivity: The XLE comes with a factory audio system that includes AM/FM, CD player, auxiliary/USB inputs and Bluetooth hands-free phone and audio streaming for easy smartphone connectivity. Steering-wheel-mounted audio and phone controls keep things safe and within reach. - Driver Assistance & Safety: Factory safety equipment includes a backup camera for easier maneuvering, anti-lock brakes (ABS), electronic stability control, traction control, and a full complement of airbags (front, side, and curtain) plus LATCH anchors for child seats. Tire pressure monitoring and an anti-theft immobilizer are also standard. - Exterior & Styling: This Sienna wears Silver Sky Metallic paint and features alloy wheels, projector-style headlights, and tasteful chrome accents that give the van a clean, modern look. This Sienna XLE combines Toyota reliability with practical family-focused features and plenty of creature comforts. With a clean CARFAX and excellent overall condition, it’s ready to go—perfect for busy families, carpooling, and road trips. Reach out to schedule a test drive or to get more details. description: This blue 2013 Toyota Sienna is the kind of minivan that makes everyday life feel a little more like a well-planned road trip. Under the hood, a 3.5L DOHC 24-valve V6 pairs with a 6-speed automatic transmission to deliver smooth, confident power—perfect for merging, climbing grades, or simply cruising with a full cabin. Up front, heated seats with temperature control help take the edge off cold mornings, while tri-zone automatic climate control keeps everyone happy across all three rows. There’s smart storage throughout, plus plenty of cup holders and power outlets to keep the cabin organized and devices charged. The wood grain-style sliding center console adds a touch of upscale flair, and the auto-dimming mirror with integrated compass is a nice bonus when you’re chasing sunsets instead of streetlights.On the outside, the Sienna’s look is clean and purposeful, with a chrome-style grille surround, LED tail lamps, fog lamps, roof rails, a rear spoiler, and a moonroof that lets in fresh air and extra daylight. Dual power sliding doors (with jam protection) and a power liftgate make loading passengers, groceries, or gear feel effortless—especially when your hands are full.Planning to bring extra toys along? This Sienna comes with a towing package designed for a 3,500-lb towing capacity, backed by heavy-duty cooling components and tow prep wiring—so weekend trailers and small campers can be part of the plan.It also brings reassuring engineering and safety fundamentals, including 4-wheel ABS, brake assist with Smart Stop Technology, stability-minded suspension, and a comprehensive airbag system with side curtains for all three rows.And for peace of mind, a CARFAX report is available for this vehicle.

Here is the complete description:2012 Mazda Mazda5 Sport FWD - White - 6-Speed Manual - Stock 100240P - Only $6,995If you have been searching for a fun-to-drive, six-passenger compact minivan that delivers real-world practicality without the minivan price tag, this 2012 Mazda Mazda5 Sport in White is exactly what you have been looking for. Priced at just $6,995, this uniquely capable and surprisingly sporty family hauler is one of the most versatile used vehicles available at any price point.A RARE FIND: THE ONLY MINIVAN WITH A MANUAL TRANSMISSIONOne of the most distinctive features of this 2012 Mazda5 Sport is its exclusive 6-speed manual transmission, a configuration that sets this vehicle apart from virtually every other family-oriented vehicle on the market. The Mazda5 Sport was the only minivan-style vehicle available with a manual gearbox, and driving enthusiasts who also happen to need family-friendly versatility have long celebrated this vehicle for exactly that reason. Paired with the responsive 2.5-liter DOHC 16-valve four-cylinder engine producing 157 horsepower and 163 lb-ft of torque, this combination delivers an engaging, driver-focused experience that no other compact van can match. Front-wheel drive rounds out the powertrain for confident, predictable handling in everyday conditions.OUTSTANDING FUEL ECONOMY FOR A SIX-PASSENGER VEHICLEWith EPA-estimated fuel economy of 21 MPG city and 28 MPG highway, the 2012 Mazda5 Sport punches well above its weight class in efficiency. This makes it one of the most fuel-friendly six-seat vehicles available anywhere near this price range, saving families real money at the pump compared to larger crossovers and full-size minivans.SIX-PASSENGER VERSATILITY IN A COMPACT, EASY-TO-PARK PACKAGEThe Mazda5 delivers full three-row, six-passenger seating in a compact footprint that is dramatically easier to maneuver and park than traditional minivans. The second row features two individual captain's chairs with armrests and convenient hidden storage compartments beneath the seat cushions, providing easy access to the third row. The 50/50 split-folding third-row seat expands cargo capacity significantly, offering up to 44.4 cubic feet of space with the third row folded, or a maximum of 89.3 cubic feet with both rear rows down for hauling larger loads. Sliding rear doors make loading and unloading passengers, car seats, and cargo effortlessly safe, eliminating the door-swinging hazards of conventional vehicles in tight parking situations. The cabin features numerous thoughtfully designed storage cubbies and compartments throughout, keeping families organized on every trip.WELL-EQUIPPED SPORT TRIM STANDARD FEATURESDespite its accessible price point, the Mazda5 Sport trim comes genuinely well-equipped from the factory. Standard features include automatic dual-zone climate control with rear vents and fan controls, a six-speaker AM/FM/CD/MP3 audio system with auxiliary audio input, full power accessories including windows, door locks and mirrors, keyless entry, cruise control with steering-wheel-mounted controls, a tilt-and-telescoping steering wheel, a height-adjustable driver seat, and a one-touch power driver window. The Mazda5 also features a deep, spacious glove box with a molded upper ledge for devices and a center console cubby perfectly sized for phones and accessories.SAFETY BUILT INTO EVERY MILEThe 2012 Mazda5 Sport was engineered with comprehensive safety technology throughout. Standard safety equipment includes all-disc anti-lock brakes with brake assist and electronic brake-force distribution, electronic stability control, traction control, and a total of six airbags including side-curtain airbags extending protection across all three rows of passengers. A Brake Override System reduces engine power when the accelerator and brake are simultaneously engaged, and non-crushable brake and accelerator pedals provide added protection in a frontal collision.SPORTY EXTERIOR STYLINGThe clean White exterior reflects Mazda's Nagare flow design philosophy, giving the Mazda5 a dynamic, forward-leaning stance that looks nothing like a conventional minivan. The Sport trim rides on 16-inch alloy wheels and features a black front grille insert that adds a sporty edge to the overall appearance. At just over 180 inches in length, the Mazda5 is sized right for urban commuting and suburban family life alike.THE SMART CHOICE FOR BUDGET-CONSCIOUS FAMILIESUsed six-passenger vehicles with real cargo flexibility, sliding doors, three-row seating, and proven reliability are rarely found at this price. The 2012 Mazda Mazda5 Sport is a uniquely compelling option for growing families, rideshare drivers, small business owners, or anyone who needs to move people and cargo efficiently without spending a fortune. At $6,995, this vehicle represents an outstanding value that is difficult to replicate elsewhere in the used car market.Do not let this one slip away.
